name: deaddrop
description: The finding half of a dead drop: a container in a public room that one player stocks and another empties without the two ever meeting. The placing half already shipped (flags.container is a hole to put things in, flags.concealed is a thing the room description refuses to mention) and the two had never met — 57 furniture rows were containers, 58 were concealed, and none was both. This adds one search.provider contributor that reports a cache to a stranger who rolls well enough, and a per-cache-per-player swept memory so a failed roll cannot be re-rolled by stepping one tile out and back. It never creates a cache and never reveals contents: the item comes out through the container plugin's own `open`. A cache also remembers being opened by a stranger (flags.dead_drop_disturbed, set through updateFurniture off the container.view hook) and tells its knower once, on their next look — that it happened, never who, because a name is a kill order and who is SPECTER's question.
